headlines.title: James Comey faces two new federal charges
headlines.description: Former FBI Director James Comey has been charged by federal prosecutors with transmission of national defense information and conspiracy to transmit national defense information. NBC News’ Ryan Reilly explains the charges.

headlines.title: AI startup Anthropic unveils its public IPO filing for the first time
headlines.description: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic unveiled its public IPO filing for the first time ahead of what is expected to be one of the largest stock debuts in history. NBC News' Allie Canal reports on the details surrounding Anthropic ahead of its IPO.

headlines.title: Israelis Set to Vote in First Election Since Oct. 7 Attacks
headlines.description: Israelis will get the opportunity to vote whether to keep Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu or replace him in the first election since the Oct. 7 attacks in 2023. New polls show Netanyahu is in a tight race with former Israeli Army Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot. NBC's Richard Engel reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Man charged with mailing threatening letters with white substance to members of Congress
headlines.description: A man has been charged in Illinois with mailing four letters containing a white granular substance to members of Congress, all of which were sent in envelopes containing his name and home address.

headlines.title: Texas redistricting confused these Latino voters, but will it affect the midterm vote?
headlines.description: The electoral map Texas redrew at President Donald Trump’s request left voters in Houston and southern Texas with unfamiliar candidates.

headlines.title: Trump offers $1 million reward for voter fraud tips that lead to convictions
headlines.description: It’s unclear where the money would come from for Trump’s latest effort to crack down on purported voter fraud ahead of the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Brazilian President Lula wins a historic fourth term
headlines.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva was re-elected for a historic fourth term in office. Lula’s far-right opponent Flavio Bolsonaro refused to concede and called for the results to be annulled after a Supreme Court ruling extended the voting by two hours.

headlines.title: Walter Koenig, actor who played Chekov on original ‘Star Trek’ series, dies at 90
headlines.description: Koenig’s death leaves William Shatner and George Takei as the last two primary cast members of the iconic science fiction show.

headlines.title: Police arrest a 15-year-old in shooting near Florida A&M stadium
headlines.description: Police have arrested a 15-year-old boy in connection with the mass shooting near Florida A&M University’s Bragg Memorial Stadium. NBC News' George Solis reports the latest updates on the investigation and the charges against the suspect.

headlines.title: How Democrats could win the House, how the GOP could hang on, and where to look for a wave
headlines.description: Three 2026 election scenarios that show which party could end up in control of the U.S. House of Representatives.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Authorities launch manhunt for convicted killer who escaped Tennessee prison
headlines.description: Authorities in Tennessee launched an intense manhunt for a convicted murderer who escaped from a state prison, allegedly stole a work truck and remains on the loose.
